limitations: The candidate family was motivated by five already observed direct losses.
Closed hourly features cannot reproduce order-book liquidity or tick order.
A historical pass still requires a genuinely new forward interval before activation.
Gross results exclude fees at user request.

protocol.direct_cluster: diagnostic only; it motivated the family and is not validation
protocol.money: client-selected current-equity margin; diagnostics use 3% and fixed 10x
protocol.pullback_guard: block when the symbol 24h move still opposes pullback direction
protocol.trend_guard: block extended direction-aligned 24h move when last closed hour reverses
